adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts` the refresh call is now routed through `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`, which (when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set) returns a response from the external sync endpoint that is documented in-code to “only contain the access token and expiry date” (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). Unlike other integrations updated in this diff (e.g., Zoom/Office365/Google) Webex does not adopt `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` to relax/normalize token-shape validation under sharing mode, so any existing strict validation (as the finding references, `webexRefreshedTokenSchema`) would reject the minimal sync payload and break refresh when sharing is enabled.
